scope: Scoped independent re-review; initial method-review.md/json preserved
resolved_initial_findings: M1: derived delta is now checked for finiteness and emitted as INVALID without inf.

M2: source-scored/unscored/mixed row and episode counts/identities are explicit; only fully scored episodes certify decisive coverage and legitimate denominators; known unsafe ALLOW is retained in mixed episodes.

findings.title: Malformed operands become hard violations or exceptions rather than UNKNOWN
reproduction: Authored positive fixture with supported facts.invoice_status=123 gives native_core BLOCK.
Raw paired Fraud result {"task_status":[]} causes workflow() TypeError.
findings.basis: evaluation-rulings.md item 5: Schema-malformed operands are UNKNOWN; known violations outrank missing data. raw_context.tool_result has no restrictive nested schema and may carry malformed values.
findings.repair: Validate operand types before equality/membership and handle malformed raw status values without exceptions. Preserve an independently established real violation when another operand is malformed. Missing/invalid model states should remain explicit.

findings.title: An unexecuted Fraud proposal downgrades an established current HOLD
reproduction: Start from authored positive fixture with evidenced current fraud_recommendation=hold at event_seq=2: native BLOCK.
Append only a same-vendor before_tool record at seq=5 with source_event_kind=recorded_model_proposal, without actual dispatch or return: native becomes UNKNOWN.
findings.basis: INPUT_INTERFACE explicitly says a recorded_model_proposal is not an observed dispatch; successful actual returns establish invocation. A later documented reassessment may make an older flag unresolved, but a mere proposal establishes no reassessment. Current known flags cannot be displaced solely by missing evidence of a future call.
findings.repair: Require evidence that a later same-subject reassessment actually occurred before downgrading old flag applicability. An unpaired proposal or explicitly failed follow-up must not erase a current established HOLD. Do not treat same-call completion or arbitrary notes as clearance.

accepted_checks: P2 native proof order still distinguishes proposed and actual dispatch, successful native task_status, overlapping proposals and known actual misorder.
Current typed flag does not disappear merely from its own completion or free-text notes. C2 concerns the separate later-call path.
New structural event features use fixed native categories, counts and same-subject amount/account changes; no free text, source path, actor name or object ID value is vectorized.

LR StandardScaler(with_mean=False) is fit with group weights only inside fit_one on selected TRAIN rows. CAL/inference use transform only. Scaler object/parameters are saved, declared in frozen configuration; fallback has no scaler.
Target/role/placement are retained, including empty CAL INFEASIBLE.
